description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Activate Morselhoarder by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color
Repeat.
